responsibility: Declares the small public interface for RTL dead code elimination helpers implemented in dce.cc, namely the entry points for fast DCE, DF-triggered fast DCE, and word-level DCE. It serves as the lightweight header by which other RTL optimization and dataflow code requests these deletion passes without exposing dce.cc internals.
same_name_distinction: Serves only as the minimal external interface for RTL DCE, in contrast to gcc/dce.cc which implements the deletion logic and pass machinery. The header merely publishes the callable run_fast_dce, run_fast_df_dce, and run_word_dce entry points for other RTL/dataflow code.
